Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Short Hair Sebastian Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of short hair Sebastian, since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including beach portraits. Including No Beard and Beard variations.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/42182070]ktruong[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/877]Sebastian - New Hair and Moto Jacket[/url] mod

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. 
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]


There are 3 versions. One is the Content Patcher version, Drag into Stardew Valley\Mods to install.

The other version (in the optional file) is replacement files for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod. To install find where you installed your DCBurger's Portrait mod (somewhere in Stardew Valley\Mods folder). Chose either "No Beard" or "Beard" version, drag the "assets" folder from my zip into the Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] DCBurger's High Res Portraits to overwrite the folder in it to install.
The replacement version prevents assets from getting loaded two times, choose whichever version you prefer/which Ever version that works for you.

Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.

I uploaded a short hair Sebastian Sprite I use myself, edited from Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Character Sprites, all credits for the sprite goes to them.


Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/42182070]ktruong[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/877]Sebastian - New Hair and Moto Jacket[/url].
The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
The sprite belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
